newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - April 25.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Friday and main factors likely to affect trading.
* Shares are seen meandering in a range as market awaits clearer direction, said Ramon Saulo, senior analyst at Asiamerit Securities.

* But Anscor-Hagedorn Securities research head Noel Reyes said negative market sentiment still permeates due to the confluence of disappointing first quarter company earnings, concerns of a property glut, and a bank closure.
* On Thursday, the Philippine stock composite index slipped 7.23 points to close at 2,906.33.
* The peso closed unchanged at 26.370 to the dollar in turnover of $178.1 million.
* Interbank call loan average was also unchanged at 10.03125 percent.
* The US Dow Jones industrial average slid 20.47 points to 6,792.25 points.
* The Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co's American Depositary Receipt gained $0 1/8 to $58 5/8.
